items.q: Mrs. McBain, and her husband, Dr. McBain, a doctor of divinity, he was the principal and she was assistant -- man and wife team there at the school.

ctx.x: Mrs. McBain, and her husband, Dr. McBain, a doctor of divinity, he was the principal and she was assistant -- man and wife team there at the school. He asked her to let the kids come out to see him at the show. So, they was glad to see Jonas and so she didn't have any school one day. She just let -- that was a free day.
Everybody could go to the circus?
